title: DesignArtifact
description: The structured design object an LLM emits in place of bot commands (spec §5). Single source of truth: schematic export and renders are deterministic derivations from it. See schema/README.md for a field reference.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this artifact contract, so the contract can evolve without breaking stored trials.

placements.description: Ordered list of placements. Array order is application order: when placements overlap, downstream expansion (T-001-02) resolves by last-writer-wins over this order.

coordinate.description: An integer voxel-lattice cell [x, y, z]. Negative values allowed (builds use a local origin).

blockId.description: A namespaced Minecraft block id, e.g. minecraft:stone_bricks. Shape only; whitelist membership is checked by the palette validator (E-04), not here.

blockState.description: Optional Minecraft block-state properties (stringly-typed), e.g. {"facing":"north","half":"bottom","waterlogged":"true"}. Carries orientation/face data the survival-buildability check (E-04) and the schematic exporter (T-002-02) need.

metadata.description: Reproducibility and trial-identity fields (spec §5, §9, §10). trial_id is the key the scoring and rating layers join on.

trial_id.description: Stable trial identifier; the join key for scores, renders, and human ratings.

prompting_method_id.description: Named, versioned prompting archetype (spec §7), so results are attributable to the method.

model_id.description: The pinned model id (a current id, not a retired one — spec §4).

seed.description: Generation seed held constant across a trial cell for comparability.

server_state_id.description: Identifier of the server/world state the trial assumes, so builds stay comparable.

target.description: Optional build target; when present the design rubric (spec §8/§9) branches on it.

style.description: The named style intent the model commits to (spec §5), enabling style scoring and post-hoc analysis.

name.description: Named style, e.g. industrial, cottagecore, brutalist, art-deco.

rationale.description: Short rationale for how the design realizes the style.

palette.description: The materials the design commits to use (spec §5/§6). manifest is declared intent; actual adherence is measured by the palette validator (E-04).

palette_id.description: Optional reference to a style-palette whitelist (T-001-04).

manifest.description: Declared set of block ids the design uses.

placement.description: A single placement, tagged by op. Exactly one shape matches; op is the discriminator so validation errors point at the matching branch.

linePlacement.description: Blocks along a straight lattice line from..to, inclusive. AXIS-ALIGNED or a uniform diagonal ONLY: every nonzero axis delta (to minus from) must have equal magnitude — e.g. [0,0,0]->[0,10,0] (vertical) or [2,2,0]->[8,8,0] (45-degree). An unequal-delta diagonal like [0,0,0]->[7,10,0] is REJECTED (no unambiguous voxelization), not rasterized. For an arbitrary slope, step it with several voxels or short axis-aligned/45-degree lines.

boxPlacement.description: The hollow rectangular shell (6 faces) spanning from..to inclusive.

fillPlacement.description: The solid cuboid spanning from..to inclusive.
